column1: # hardware-profiles.tsv — exact Mac SKU → named lineup (lm init)
# NOT an install SSOT (that remains config/*.manifest).
# Exact match key: (family, variant, mem_gb bucket). No nearest-RAM fallback.
# chip_regex: optional extra check against the probed chip string.
# gpu_cores: optional; compared only when both the row and the probe have a value.
# family: m3|m4|m5   variant: base|pro|max|ultra   mem_gb: advertised unified memory
# M1/M2 are intentionally absent → lm init uses the scoring fallback.
